arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made with Mastercard cards, across the full data range from January to October 2019.
assumptions: Counted all transactions regardless of fraud label, since the question does not mention labels.
Covers the full data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
